children: Faraday Future regained compliance with Nasdaq's $2.5M equity standard after reducing liabilities and boosting stockholders' equity.
Regained Nasdaq Equity Standard compliance as of July 31, 2026 and maintained it through the latest report.
Reduced notes payable by approximately $10.0M and derivative call option liability by ~$5.8M.
Accounts payable and accrued liabilities fell about $15.3M, driven by a $13.5M drop in employee-related liabilities.
Cumulative EAI robot sales and shipments reached 552 units by end of August with positive product gross margin.
